claims.claim: A South Korean container ship finished a round-trip from Busan to Rotterdam via the Northern Sea Route in 50 days.

claims.supporting_quote: The ship made the round trip from Busan to Rotterdam in just 50 days, saving at least 10 days compared to the fastest travel times along the more commonly used Suez Canal route.

claims.episode_span: The Northern Sea Route is not only around 7,000 kilometers shorter, it also avoids the geopolitical flashpoint of the Middle East.

claims.episode_span: The container vessel PanStar Acro left the South Korean port of Busan on August 22 and navigated around Russia to reach the southern British port of Felixstowe, then continued its journey by sailing to Rotterdam in the Netherlands and Gdansk in Poland, before heading back along the NSR.
